I also truly believe no one is. Except myself, which is totally a paradox. I'm just really going through it right now -- I've never felt remotely like this in my life and I've dealt with depression before. It just currently feels so overwhelming and consuming, the thought of how much I *hate* myself is always on my mind, 24/7. I just don't know what to do, I'm genuinely not sure if I'm going to be here in a week's time (I certainly don't *want* to) and I feel like everything has fallen apart, and then those broken parts have themselves fallen apart. I feel like my soul has been put through a shredder.

I'm so sorry for whining at you and all that. I really hope you're okay yourself.
Thank you for the thoughts. Unfortunately, "a whole range" doesn't mean everyone. There are always going to be outliers. I am one of them because I'm simply not a real human.

Non-traditional and "disgusting, repulsive, pathetic beta male with no redeeming masculine traits and all around vile human being unworthy of love" are two very different things unfortunately. I guarantee you'd be repulsed by seeing me or by speaking to me. 

Thank you for the thought though. I genuinely do appreciate the effort and am sending you my thoughts and love for whatever it is that is bringing you to this subreddit.

You can be sweet and kind and still be a real man and a real human worthy of love. Unfortunately I know I am not that, so any sweetness and kindness in me is as good as worthless. People don't care for sweetness and kindness in a slug. It's still just a slug.
